text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is drawing near, and attention starts to focus on the showdown between Narita Brian and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap makes it clear that she won't relinquish victory, while Narita Brian quietly ignites her own competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Biwa Hayahide learns that Narita Brian is aiming for the Senior Autumn Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's holding out hope that she'll be able to make it in time for year's end.
